item.title: Why Québec’s La Grande and Opinaca Subprovinces are Gaining Attention from Gold Explorers
item.description: The James Bay region of Northern Québec sits within the Superior Province, one of the world’s oldest and most metal-endowed Archean crustal blocks. While iconic gold districts like the Abitibi have seen generations of exploration and mine development, other Archean terrains in Québec — notably the La Grande and Opinaca subprovinces — remain relatively underexplored. item.title: Top 10 Central Bank Gold Reserves
item.description: Global central banks own about 17 percent of all the gold ever mined, with reserves topping 36,520.7 metric tons (MT) at the end of November 2025. They acquired the vast majority after becoming net buyers of the metal in 2010.Central banks purchase gold for a number of reasons: to mitigate risk, to hedge against inflation and to promote economic stability.
